description: What a name or a link is on RoTerminal: the games, studios and Roblox groups, people and topics (genres, trend words) it could mean, the best guess first, each with how to read it further. Use it first for any name that may not be a game: “kuzu” is the studio KUZU. A pasted roblox.com or roterminal.co link or id goes straight to that thing. People are matched however their name is typed, and each says what kind they are: a RoTerminal member, a Roblox account, or both. With a game or studio as context, people tied to it come first. `ask` means two people fit: ask which.

context.description: The game or studio it’s about, when the question names one (optional)

query.description: The name, @username, id or link, as it was written
